poems.title: How to Break off an Engagement
poems.note: the island the bay took — no building left standing (OSM: 0)

set_pieces.name: Tambourine through the chapel window
set_pieces.line: 3 HOW TO BREAK OFF AN ENGAGEMENT · A Tambourine through the chapel window — “Ode to forever—”

set_pieces.name: The empty temple
set_pieces.line: 3 HOW TO BREAK OFF AN ENGAGEMENT · B The empty temple — “empty choir stands,”

set_pieces.name: Gifts at the side doors
set_pieces.line: 3 HOW TO BREAK OFF AN ENGAGEMENT · C Gifts at the side doors — “spirits have / left salvations”

set_pieces.name: The storm
set_pieces.line: 3 HOW TO BREAK OFF AN ENGAGEMENT · D The storm — “it thunders.”

set_pieces.name: Remnants on the shore
set_pieces.line: 3 HOW TO BREAK OFF AN ENGAGEMENT · E Remnants on the shore — “Ode to the storm ending.”

set_pieces.name: Tambourine shatters
set_pieces.line: 3 HOW TO BREAK OFF AN ENGAGEMENT · F Tambourine shatters — “& a tambourine / shattered into pieces.”

foundry_refs.desc: Marble pillars crumble to dust in slow motion, particles glowing.

foundry_refs.line: A broken promise. Glistening red fluid submersion and shorelines of release.
